name: command
useFor: Use CommandDialog for a palette opened with Command K (new thread, open a terminal, go to pull requests), or Command inline for a searchable list of actions. Put CommandInput first, then CommandList with CommandEmpty, CommandGroup (heading), CommandItem (onSelect) and CommandSeparator; CommandShortcut shows the keys. Built on cmdk, with the dialog on Base UI Dialog.
constraints: A highlight that slides between rows
More than one palette per app
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: the nav popup (.hn__panel, .hn__item), Kode Mono labels (.label) and the 32 percent ink scrim
title: Command
description: A command palette: the site's square popup panel with a 48px search row over the quiet rule, Kode Mono group labels, 36px rows on the hover wash when highlighted and Kode Mono shortcuts at the end; the dialog opens and closes without motion. A long list fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-y).
